question.text:
You are given two sorted arrays, each of length $n$. What is the best possible time complexity (in the worst case) to find the median of the combined $2 n$ elements?

  1. $O(n)$
     
  2. $O(\log n)$
     
  3. $O(n \log n)$
     
  4. $O(1)$
question.subject: Algorithms

question.text:
Consider the following functions:

  • $p(n)=5^{n^2}$
     
  • $q(n)=n^{1000}$
     
  • $r(n)=2^{\log _2 n}$

Which of the following statements about the asymptotic relationships among $p(n), q(n)$, and $r(n)$ is correct?

  1. $p(n)=O(q(n))$ and $q(n)=O(r(n))$
     
  2. $p(n)=\Omega(q(n))$ and $q(n)=O(r(n))$
     
  3. $q(n)=O(p(n))$ and $r(n)=O(p(n))$
     
  4. $q(n)=\Omega(p(n))$ and $r(n)=\Omega(q(n))$
question.subject: Algorithms

question.text:
The asymptotic complexity of 4 functions $f_1, f_2, f_3, f_4$ are

  1. $f_1(n)=2^n$
     
  2. $f_2(n)=n^{(3 / 2)}$
     
  3. $f_3(n)=n \log n$
     
  4. $f_4(n)=n^{(\log n)}$

Arrange them in increasing order of complexity.

  1. $f_2, f_3, f_4, f_1$
     
  2. $f_1, f_2, f_3, f_4$
     
  3. $f_3, f_2, f_4, f_1$
     
  4. $f_3, f_1, f_2, f_4$
question.subject: Algorithms

question.text:
Consider the recurrence relation:

$$
T(n)=3 T\left(\frac{n}{2}\right)+n, \quad T(1)=1
$$


The asymptotic complexity of this recurrence is:

  1. $O(n \log n)$
     
  2. $O\left(n^{\log _2 3}\right)$
     
  3. $O\left(n^2\right)$
     
  4. $O\left(\log ^2 n\right)$
question.subject: Algorithms

question.text:
Which of the following statements is/are true for all positive functions $f(n)$ ?
(Multiple options may be correct.)

  1. $f(2 n)=\Theta(f(n))$
     
  2. $f(2 n)=o\left(f(n)^2\right)$
     
  3. $f(2 n)=O(f(n))$
     
  4. $f(n)^2=O\left(f(n)^2\right)$
question.subject: Algorithms
